description: Search and filter verified Gauteng event and celebration venues (weddings, baby showers, birthdays, year-end, corporate, private celebrations) by event type, location/suburb, guest capacity, layout setting, and budget envelope. Returns up to 10 curated venues with unedited Google ratings and pricing details.

budgetMax.description: Maximum budget envelope in South African Rand (ZAR) (e.g., 30000)

suburb.description: Gauteng suburb or area (e.g., 'Pretoria East', 'Muldersdrift', 'Sandton', 'Centurion', 'Bryanston', 'Magaliesburg', 'Rosebank', 'Hyde Park')

name: find_venues
